prompt: A cinematic shot from a Chinese wuxia film, set in an ancient library with towering wooden bookshelves and dim, flickering lantern light casting long shadows. In the center of the frame, an ancient and worn book floats in mid-air, its pages glowing faintly as a circular energy formation, pulsing with intricate symbols, materializes within its open pages. The energy radiates with an eerie light, casting mysterious reflections onto the surrounding manuscripts and ancient scrolls. A 30-year-old man stands before the book, dressed in torn white martial arts robes, his long black hair flowing lightly with the unseen current in the room. His stance is steady, yet his eyes reflect a mixture of awe and caution, as if he senses the immense power contained within the energy formation. The background is filled with old wooden shelves, filled with scrolls and manuscripts, and the atmosphere is thick with a sense of mystery, danger, and ancient knowledge. --ar 9:16 --v 6.1
